map: All That Glitters Extended v1.0.2 (15360x10240, 437 spots; enemy start about 10,000 away on foot)
people: [gecko]thebluegecko (lobby 34.34), Cortex vehicles (the start script and record header said Armada; every unit of his seen was Cortex). Spectators: computer_whisperer (the user), [gecko]u6bkep (19.24), [gecko]Covariance (16.84); neither of the latter two typed.
our_side: Three seats: t1 red Armada F8 (record-0), t2 green Armada H8 (record-1), t3 magenta Cortex C8 (record-2). One Opus 5.5 medium player over all three seats (mode 'player', one packet for every seat's hands), Jev jev-latest hands per seat, hands_effort normal, no commander seat; the standing brief docs/briefs/player.md. Rebuilt hands of 2026-10-02/03.
summary: We out-expanded him early (side 91 extractors at 9:28, 112 at 17:16) and the report showed an army lead of 4-30x over what we saw, but the lead was against a floor: the side never scouted his half, his base was found only at 10:09 (E2) and his units destroyed in our sight already came to 19.7k metal by 16:00 and 74k by 22:00. Our pressure went at his base side (F1/F2) as trickles of Blitzes into Exploiters, Pounders and then Twin Guard nests, while from 9:28 every new group was a home guard, so magenta's army (13.7k-36.6k from 16:00) stood in C6-C8 for 18 minutes. The hands split groups into detachments chasing raiders; his Brute raids took magenta's home from 44 to 16 extractors at 18:36-21:43 while its guard held. He reached tier 2 unseen (Tzar reported 22:02, Tigers 25:49) and raised 138 of our dead with Graverobbers; his Tzar push broke the east seats from 26:44, both Armada commanders died at 29:46 and 30:54, and the engine closed the game at 32:19. The one player's turns slowed from 15.7 s to 30.3 s and its notes named each problem minutes after it began (the ledger's reading).

bears_on.note: The user said at 5:11-5:24 what the lesson says of a greedy expander ('an agressive responce is needed'); our raid hit his defended base side instead of his spread spots and his economy grew unseen to about our size.
We did the 'keep taking mexes' half (112 extractors at 17:16) and not 'raiding the corners'; expansion alone did not hold against an unraided person on a 437-spot map.
The end was the economy: extractors 112 at 17:16, 86 at 20:07, 63 at 27:24, 39 at 29:26, 9 at 31:45, while the trade the player read was even or positive.
The groups never fought as one: red's Blitzes and Stouts fed into F2-F4, green's into G3-F4, magenta's body stayed west; the player's own 16:13 and 27:24 notes say so.

A seen lead of 38.5k against about 5k at 16:13 was never taken into him, but it was against a floor (his destroyed-in-sight 19.7k by then): the lesson needs a lead measured against his estimate, not his sightings.
Blitzes and Stouts sent head-on into Exploiters and Twin Guard nests at F2, F3, F4 (13:40, 15:30, 22:21) bled each time.
'go arround rather than attack the strongest postition': 19 Stouts lost in 27 s at the F3 nest at 23:15.
Blitzes into Pounders and Brutes lost; the player switched to Stouts and Whistlers only at 14:01.
From his side: Graverobbers raised 138 of our dead from the fields our piecemeal attacks left, 89 of them by 25:00.
Stores high with build power missing: magenta's energy empty 42% of the game with 2.7-4.4k metal banked; 6.2k banked at 17:54.

lens.caveats: No truth file: every number of his is a floor, and the root rests on the reader's inference that his economy neared ours by about 18:00 (his destroyed-in-sight units), with the user's 5:11-5:24 lines as the person's support. analyze_match and minutes read only the first record, so seats 1 and 2 were run from scratch directories linking record-1 and record-2 as record-0; the 'his' columns are the side's shared sight and the same in each seat. pro_baseline not run (not Comet Catcher); impedance_sweep not run. raid_ledger's 'answered 0' may reflect this record's era. The ledger's '63 extractors at 27:24' is ours (note 27:24). The main session's reading (ledger, commander-seat design) puts the cause at the unspent lead of 12:14-16:13 and the one-player structure; this row puts the root earlier and calls the lead a floor. Scratch note: this reader briefly overwrote bot.log, script.txt and strategist-0.jsonl links in the shared scratchpad dirs seat1/ and seat2/ of the 1792547311-human reader (about 00:33-00:34) and restored them to that game's files; that reader's runs in that minute may have read human-18 files.
